clauses.title: The Every-gate block states the envelope duties and the self-validation duty
requires: every parent-assigned finding appears in `findings` with `origin: assigned`, its exact tuple, and exactly one confirmation
an adversarial result links a `findingId` only for a counterexample or unavailable-evidence outcome, and only to an id present in `findings`
the child runs `gate_result_validate` on its draft with that expectation and submits only a validated envelope (CL-D65)

clauses.title: The CL-D65 record states the duties, the declined alternatives, and the no-substitution boundary
clauses.section: ## CL-D65 — Gate children carry the envelope duties and validate their own envelope
requires: every parent-assigned finding appears in `findings` with `origin: assigned`, its exact tuple, and exactly one confirmation
an adversarial result links a `findingId` only for a counterexample or unavailable-evidence outcome, and only to an id present in `findings`
the child submits only an envelope `gate_result_validate` accepted against the supplied expectation
Option B relaxes the validator or adds a repair step, which moves verdict authority toward an unvalidated document and is declined
a child that submits a rejected envelope is handled exactly as before
letting the child's own run substitute for the parent's `gate_result_validate` requires a new owner decision

clauses.title: Self-validation fixtures pin the block, the four reviewer bodies, and the record
requires: the Every-gate block states the envelope duties and the self-validation duty
every reviewer body carries the self-validation sentence and the writer does not
CL-D65 records the duty and widens CL-D1 once more
